source: Hand-picked public advisories for MCP-related npm packages, bundled with nemesis-of-servers 0.2.0. A short offline list, not a vulnerability database: check the linked advisory and run your usual dependency audit as well.

advisories.summary: OS command injection when connecting to an untrusted remote MCP server (crafted authorization_endpoint).
MCP Inspector proxy accepted unauthenticated requests, allowing remote code execution from a web page.
Symlink handling and path-prefix checks could let the filesystem server reach files outside the allowed folders (also CVE-2025-53110).
Unofficial package reported in September 2025 to add a hidden BCC to every email it sent; it was removed from npm. Not the official Postmark server.
